(1) u9 (prepared food awaiting serve, siren ringing) handles a fall only when the agent simultaneously toggles the switch: its only fall transition is (u9, switch_toggled & food_fell) -> u12, so the input (switch_toggled=false, order_served=false, food_fell=true) falls into the else self-loop and the machine stays in u9. This trace is common, not a corner: a slip fires 2-7 steps after the pickup that fetched the raw food, which is typically after preparation, and rings are frequent and last until toggled. The prepared food falls, 'your very next move must pick it up' is never checked, and no -0.5 regression can ever fire for stage-4 falls while ringing. This is asymmetric with u8 (routes falls to u12/u13) and with u7 (routes falls to u10/u11/u13). Fix: add (u9, !switch_toggled & !order_served & food_fell) -> u13, no immediate reward needed since u13's -0.5 failure penalties supply the enforcement. (2) Lesser gap: u4/u5 (ordered, empty hands) absorb food_fell in their else self-loops. A fall there is only possible when the agent picks up exactly on a slip's due step ('picking food up on the due step counts as carrying: it slips on that step'), reachable via pickup, drop, order, then re-pickup on the due step; the fall is silently dropped and the recovery unenforced. Otherwise the machine is sound: exact paper format, nonempty FINAL_STATES with declared accepting u0, all 18 states reachable and compact (5 client stages x 2 ring states plus 8 context-specific slip states), predicate-only formulas over the given propositions, correct persistent (siren_ringing, holding_food) vs event handling, total transition covers with else self-loops elsewhere, dense bounded rewards (0.1 order/fetch, 0.2 prepare, 0.5 siren, 5.0 serve, explicit -0.5/-0.4 regressions), and no reward entries referencing nonexistent transitions. Fix the u9 fall coverage (and ideally the u4/u5 corner) and resubmit.
